text_block_list.text:
Having woken up early, I headed to the 
academy while enjoying the crisp morning 
air—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning, Trainer. It's a lovely 
morning, isn't it?
choice_data_list: You seem to be in good condition.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perhaps because I was able to rest 
well yesterday, I had such pleasant 
dreams...
choice_data_list: What kind of dream was it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, in my dream, I became the wind and 
raced across a vast grassy plain...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My body felt as light as air, like I could 
fly away to anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I feel like I can run like the 
wind today.

Silence Suzuka had rested well in body and 
mind, and was overflowing with motivation.
